practice.title: Math guided practice · Area and perimeter applications

items.prompt: A rectangle is 12 cm by 4 cm. Find its perimeter.
items.answer: 32 cm

items.prompt: A rectangle has area 36 square cm and width 4 cm. Find its length.
items.answer: 9 cm

items.prompt: Two rectangles are 3 by 8 cm and 4 by 6 cm. Compare their areas and perimeters.
items.answer: Both areas are 24 square cm. Perimeters are 22 cm and 20 cm; equal area does not guarantee equal perimeter.

contexts: W2 data: A fictional class compares water collection in two labeled trials using the same time interval. Trial A: 12 milliliters of water collected; Trial B: 20 milliliters of water collected. These are invented assessment data, not a claim about a real investigation.

items.prompt: Use W2 data. State one observation without claiming its cause.
